message: Several small fixes: recipe amounts written with a long dash ("1–2 cups") now scale at both ends, "14-oz can" scales by the can, "1-inch piece" doubles to "2-inch piece", 450 g shows as 1 lb instead of 16 oz, and price comparisons no longer rank different can sizes against each other. "Next weekend" said on a Sunday now means the coming weekend, and "daily for 10 days" now repeats 10 times instead of 11. After midnight but before your day starts, "in 30 min", "tonight" and "3pm" now count from the actual time instead of landing in the past. A 1 kg per week weight goal no longer reopens as 0.9, and a scanned whole package can be edited after logging.
